$casa_todo_2026_07_28.scope: /casa landing page — remaining backlog items 002/003/004 (001 was already complete).

001.note: page-home.php lines ~434-510 already match the exact spec: #cecece->#aaa rest/scrolled, #666666CC->#66666680 login icon, 1.25vh threshold, !important on all listed selectors.

002.what: Hero title now rotates through 9 supplied PT/EN phrases using an n3xt()-style flip/slide swap (adapted from the user-supplied reference script). Fixed 2-row height via em-based calc(2em*0.95) — tracks the existing clamp() font-size at any viewport, no JS measuring.
002.side_effect_fixed: The existing casa-hero ScrollTrigger tweened per-character .split-char spans queried once at page load; since the title text now changes every ~3s, those spans would go stale after the first swap and the scroll-collapse effect would silently animate detached nodes. Retargeted that tween to the stable .nh-hero-typer wrapper as one unit — same visual effect, safe against the rotating content.

Re-targeted ST2's scrub to the section head only (.nh-section-head) so cards keep .reveal-up untouched and are driven purely by reveal-up.js's own IntersectionObserver + auto-stagger (--ap-d, 115ms/sibling, per the uploaded reveal-up.js) — matches the user's exact ask. /casa still holds >=3 ScrollTriggers (casa-hero, casa-events [now on the head], casa-crash). token_compliance_audit.what: Audited new-home.css against core.js's :root block. Fixed exact/near-exact hex matches to tokens (--alert-warning, --alert-icon, --onyx-600/700/800, --platinum-400) and color-mix()-derived danger-hover shades from --alert-icon (matching the --alert-card precedent already in core.js). Fixed 5 usages of var(--bg-deep) — a token that does not exist in core.js or locally, silently resolving to nothing — to var(--onyx-700). Converted ~14 raw px icon/UI font-sizes to calc(var(--fs-u, 1) * Npx) so they respect the user's font-scale preference like the rem-based sizes already do (rem was left as-is: html's font-size is var(--fs-p), which already bakes in --fs-u, so rem values were already compliant).
token_compliance_audit.deliberately_left_unchanged: var(--token, #hexfallback) CSS-fallback patterns; #000/transparent mask-image gradient stops (mask math, not color); .nh-hero-title's literal #fff (documented: hero text always white over video); the many literal #fff on badges/chips/explore-card/marquee (fixed-white-on-fixed-color-or-photo surfaces — forcing these to theme-relative tokens like --white-1 would break contrast in dark mode, since --white-1 flips with theme); a #333/#1a1a1a decorative gradient and a map-popup #FF6925 tag accent with no corresponding core.js token.

out_now_tracks.what: tracks.php now calls apollo_get_latest_dj_tracks(5) (new aggregator in apollo-djs) and renders real tracks (newest release first, across all DJs) when any exist; falls back to the existing simulated placeholder covers only pre-launch (zero real tracks). out_now_tracks.closes_gap: This also closes the front-end read-path KNOWN GAP recorded in $dj_tracks_schema_v2 / registry/20-meta-schemas.json#_dj_tracks — see apollo-djs.json for the apollo_dj_get_tracks() migration.

$casa_hero_rotator_fix_2026_07_28.scope: Live-site follow-up after $casa_luxury_pass_2026_07_28b — user checked https://apollo.rio.br/casa/ and reported the hero phrase rotator wasn't running. Bumped 1.3.8 -> 1.3.9.
$casa_hero_rotator_fix_2026_07_28.finding: $casa_todo_2026_07_28.002 had marked the item-002 hero rotator DONE in an earlier phase, and the CSS scaffolding (.nh-hero-typer/.t3xt-out/.t3xt-in/@keyframes nhTyperOut/nhTyperIn) was genuinely present in new-home.css with a comment pointing at 'new-home.js hero phrase rotator' — but that JS block did not actually exist in new-home.js. Registry claim did not match disk state; confirmed via grep before writing anything.
$casa_hero_rotator_fix_2026_07_28.fix:
Added a heroPhraseRotator() IIFE to new-home.js (top of file, after NAVBAR SCROLL) driving .nh-hero-typer-view through the 9 supplied PT/EN phrases via the existing n3xt()-style .t3xt-out/.t3xt-in swap. Phrases contain inline HTML (
, , , ) so swaps use innerHTML, not textContent. Respects prefers-reduced-motion (falls back to a plain non-animated swap on the same cadence). Pure CSS-animation driven, no GSAP dependency — starts on DOMContentLoaded regardless of GSAP load state.

scroll_trigger_adjustment.what: casa-hero ScrollTrigger start changed from 'top top' to 'center top'. Hero sits at document position 0, so 'top top' was satisfied at scrollY=0 (page load) — no visible before/after contrast, matching the user's 'moment 0 of viewport, impossible to see' diagnosis. 'center top' gives a static first half-screen of scroll before the video-scale + title-collapse scrub kicks in over the second half.
scroll_trigger_adjustment.caveat: Not verified in a live browser (no browser automation available in this environment) — reasoned from the ScrollTrigger start/end semantics and the hero's document position. Flagged for the user to confirm visually.

$hero_rotator_quality_pass_2026_07_28.reason: User feedback on the first rotator pass: block-flip swap read as too fast / low quality ('chatgpt + magic ui'). Asked for a refined, luxury-grade letter-by-letter animation instead. Bumped 1.3.9 -> 1.3.10.
$hero_rotator_quality_pass_2026_07_28.fix: Replaced the whole-block .t3xt-out/.t3xt-in CSS-keyframe swap with a GSAP + SplitText per-CHARACTER cascade: outgoing phrase's chars drift up + fade (0.4s, stagger 0.012, power2.in), then incoming phrase's chars rise + fade in (0.7s, stagger 0.02, power3.out). Cadence slowed from 2.8s to 4.2s between transitions. Gated on window.Apollo.whenReady (SplitText only settles after apollo:ready, same gate the ScrollTrigger luxury pass uses) with a poll-then-degrade fallback to a plain non-animated swap if GSAP/SplitText never load, plus a separate reduced-motion path — the hero is never left stuck on one phrase.
$hero_rotator_quality_pass_2026_07_28.cleanup: Removed the now-fully-unreferenced .t3xt/.t3xt-out/.t3xt-in classes, @keyframes nhTyperOut/nhTyperIn, and .nh-hero-typer's perspective:700px (no 3D rotateX in the new design) from new-home.css — the char-level animation is pure inline-style GSAP, no CSS animation classes needed.

$casa_bugfix_batch_2026_07_28c.reason: User reported 6 concrete defects on the live /casa page after the event-card-contract fix, several caused by side effects of prior fixes (blunt, itemized feedback with a corner-notch screenshot).
fixes: Footer: mobile .nh-footer transform pushed from translateY(18%) to translateY(32%) — user said the prior value wasn't enough.
.ax-login icon: removed the stray `font: 600 13px/1 var(--ff-main)` shorthand in templates/page-home.php's inline

Event card corners: root cause was core.js's global `* { corner-shape: squircle; }` interacting with .a-eve-media's plain border-radius corners (the ones NOT covered by the manual mask/gradient corner-notch trick), exaggerating them beyond the intended --a-eve-r radius. The notch corner near the date badge is pixel-exact via the mask gradients and was unaffected — matches the user's red(wrong)/green(correct) screenshot exactly. Added `corner-shape: round;` to .a-eve-media, .a-eve-card, and .a-eve-explore in new-home.css to force standard circular arcs, consistent with the existing corner-shape:round pattern already used elsewhere in this codebase (e.g. apollo-admin/assets/modera/css/modera.css .role-switch button).

.a-eve-explore ("ALL Eventos" CTA): was stretching to the full height of a real event card (date+media+content) because CSS Grid's default align-items:stretch pulls every item in a row to the tallest sibling's height, and the card's own min-height:280px never actually constrained it. Replaced min-height:280px with aspect-ratio:4/5 (matching .a-eve-media's own height:0;padding-bottom:125% ratio) + align-self:start, so it now matches only the image-area height instead of the full card.

Dropdowns forced to backdrop-filter: blur(20px) !important (both prefixed and unprefixed) across every live floating/glass panel on /casa: .nh-menu-sheet, .nh-dropdown (covers --apps/--profile variants, which don't declare their own backdrop-filter), .nh-month-row (both the mobile floating state, previously blur(13px), and the >=600px inline-row state, which previously explicitly disabled blur with `backdrop-filter:none`), and .apps-pop in the shared apollo-events/styles/base/template-parts/shared/shell-styles.php (previously blur(128px), now standardized to 20px like the rest). Left .panel-r/.ax-aside/.ax-overlay untouched — those are solid slide-in side panels / dimming scrims, a different UI pattern from the floating glass dropdowns the user's example (.nh-month-row) represents.

$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.reason: User opened an 11-phase programme to convert every mockup screen (FEED, EVENTOS, MARKETPLACE, COMUNA, HUB.RIO, REDUCAO DE DANOS, MAPA + the 5 'meus/minhas' dashboards) into modular template-parts mounted on the Blank Canvas Apollo+ page template, with the Design System aside links fixed. Phase 001 is the Feed.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.shell_foundation: This phase deliberately builds the SHARED foundation every later phase reuses, not just the Feed. New includes/apollo-plus-api.php exposes apollo_plus_open() / apollo_plus_close() / apollo_plus_part(). A screen is now a mount point: open the shell, render its layout part, close. apollo_plus_part() resolves child theme -> parent theme -> plugin, so any screen or widget can be overridden without touching the plugin that ships it.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.aside_built: THE GAP FLAGGED EARLIER IS NOW CLOSED. app-shell.php only ever rendered the topbar (.ax-top); the .ax-aside sidebar -- the 'mandatory header' the user meant -- did not exist in WordPress at all. Built as template-parts/apollo-plus/aside.php + aside-styles.php, CSS ported verbatim from layout.html (.ax-aside/.s/.nb/.ni/.si/.fs/.ft/.adj/.urow). Renders for GUESTS AND MEMBERS alike (primary nav is chrome, not a member feature); only the Gestor group and user row are auth-gated.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.aside_links_fixed: Mockup hash routes (#/feed, #/anuncios ...) replaced with REAL WordPress URLs resolved against the registry: /feed, /eventos, /anuncios, /comunas, /hub, /mapa, plus Reducao de Danos as an external target=_blank to https://sos.apollo.rio.br/. The active row is resolved SERVER-SIDE from the request path (exact segment or path-prefix, never substring, so /eventos/meus lights up Eventos but /anuncios never matches /anu) -- correct on first paint, no JS, no flash.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.labels_enforced: Suporte button carries data-apollo-suporte (the ecosystem-wide hook apollo-suporte.js binds to). The preferences row is labelled 'Ajustes' with icon ri-compasses-2-line, replacing the mockup's 'Preferencias' + flask SVG -- per the user's standing rule that every preferences/settings/config surface uses that label and icon.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.feed_modularised: page-feed.php went from a 1131-line monolith to a 58-line mount point. Extracted into parts: apollo-plus/aside, feed/styles (the monolith's 14KB style block preserved verbatim so the visual result is unchanged), feed/layout, feed/header, feed/composer, feed/stream, feed/post, and six sidebar widgets under feed/widgets/. The monolith is kept at templates/_legacy/page-feed.monolith.php for rollback.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.no_simulated_data: MANDATORY CONSTRAINT HONOURED: simulated.data.js is NOT ported. Only the SHAPE of its globals is honoured so the mockup's structure and scripts keep working, while every value comes from WordPress via the new includes/feed-data.php (apollo_feed_greeting/news/events/market/trending/nucleos/stats). Each provider returns [] when its source CPT/taxonomy does not exist yet, so a widget renders its empty state instead of inventing content -- the feed stream in particular has NO fixture fallback by design: an empty scene shows an empty state, never invented activity.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.widget_contract: Sidebar widgets keep the mockup's [app="app-widget-*"] mount attribute even though they are now server-rendered, so the ported runtime scripts can re-hydrate the same node in place later without a markup change. Class contract (.sb-card/.sb-title/.sb-news-item/.news-cat/.news-title/.news-time/.sb-see-more/.sb-status) copied from app-widget-*.js so feed.css applies unchanged.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.privacy_carried_forward: The marketplace widget prints title + price ONLY, never the seller -- the site-wide advert seller-privacy rule established earlier this session must not be undone by a new surface.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.verification: Brace/paren/bracket + PHP alt-syntax balance on all 17 new/changed files (all balanced). Deployed via RealTimeSync (34s wait) and confirmed https://apollo.rio.br/casa still renders fully, which proves apollo-templates 1.4.0 -- including the two new requires -- loads with no fatal. /feed itself CANNOT be verified anonymously: it is auth:true and redirects guests to /acesso, which is exactly the documented behaviour. Logged-in rendering of the Feed screen is still UNVERIFIED and should be eyeballed by the user while signed in.
$phase_001_feed_apollo_plus_2026_07_28.next_phases: 002 EVENTOS (/eventos + /portal) can now reuse apollo_plus_open()/aside directly -- the Portal de Eventos built earlier this session should be re-mounted onto the shell. 003 Marketplace, 004 Comuna, 005 Hub.rio + Reducao de Danos, 006 Mapa (apollo-maps has no page/route yet -- real build gap), 007-011 the dashboards. $aside_review_fixes_2026_07_28.reason: Two defects reported against the phase-001 aside during the phase-002 review.
$aside_review_fixes_2026_07_28.fix_suporte_hitarea: REPORTED: 'suporte HAS NO data-apollo-suporte on the entire clickable area of Suporte'. Correct: the attribute sat only on the <button>, while the icon and the label are what the pointer actually lands on -- so if the support runtime matches the event TARGET rather than walking up to the nearest [data-apollo-suporte] ancestor, clicks on the glyph or on the word 'Suporte' hit nothing. FIX: children are made click-transparent in CSS (.supportBTN>i,>svg,>.sn{pointer-events:none}) AND carry the hook themselves, so the whole row is live regardless of which selector strategy the runtime uses -- belt and braces, because the runtime lives in another file and its strategy can change.
$aside_review_fixes_2026_07_28.fix_ajustes_gating: REPORTED: 'Ajustes is shown only for logged users true'. It was rendering for guests too. FIX: the whole .adj row (Ajustes link + dark-mode pill) is now inside the $apl_logged branch -- there is nothing for a guest to adjust and /ajustes requires a session, so showing it only offered a dead end. The primary nav above it stays guest-visible, unchanged.

$listing_header_block_2026_08_08.scope: NEW SHARED BLOCK — apollo_listing_header(). Version bump 1.5.0 -> 1.5.1.
$listing_header_block_2026_08_08.what: The month/search/filter band at the top of an archive-style Apollo screen, shipped as a reusable template-part block. Ported from the approved lab file screen/portal/header listing/header-of-listing-events.html, section 'Header 02 · Kinetic Mask · Apple' (the second of the three variants in that file).
$listing_header_block_2026_08_08.why_here_and_not_in_apollo_events: It is page chrome that more than one listing will want, and 18-canvas-shell puts Apollo+ chrome plus the apollo_plus_part() include API in apollo-templates. Putting it in the first plugin that happened to need it (apollo-events) would have made every future listing depend on the events plugin for its header.
$listing_header_block_2026_08_08.not_a_fourth_shell: IMPORTANT given $unification_2026_08_05 in 18-canvas-shell: this is a BLOCK, not a shell. It emits no <head>, no <body>, no topbar and no aside. It renders inside whatever container the caller already opened — normally .ax-main from apollo_plus_open() — and it does not call any shell function.

functions: apollo_listing_header_months( array $counts = [] ) — twelve localized rows ready for the 'months' arg
apollo_listing_header_args() / apollo_listing_header_groups() — normalisers, public so a caller can pre-validate
api.filter: apollo/listing_header/skins — register another skin without touching the block

structure.templates/template-parts/listing-header/: orchestrator — the only part a page includes; guards the shared layers so N headers on one page emit kernel CSS/JS once
structure.kernel-styles.php: overlay + filter primitives shared by every skin
structure.kernel-scripts.php: window.ApolloListingHeader — instance registry, circular clip-path wipe, month mask-swap, CustomEvents
structure.skins/apple.php: the Header 02 look; a skin only restyles, the markup contract is skin-independent
structure.parts/{actions,month,scrub}.php: the header row, the kinetic month/year, the 12-segment scrubber
structure.parts/{overlay-search,overlay-filter,fil: the two full-viewport panels; overlays are siblings of <header> so they are not trapped in its stacking context

$listing_header_block_2026_08_08.controlled_component: The block never fetches, never filters and never knows what a month contains. It emits apollo:lh:{month,search,filter,clear} and accepts state back through setMonth()/setMonths(). The screen owns the data — that is what makes it reusable.
$listing_header_block_2026_08_08.data_flow_rule_honoured: The lab built its filter chips in JS from a hard-coded APOLLO_TAXONOMY literal. That was NOT ported: per 03-apollo-rule.$apollo_rule.data_flow the PHP array is the source of truth, so chips are server-rendered from terms the caller passes. A group with zero options is dropped; zero groups prints one empty state. Nothing is invented.

conventions.icons: bare <i class="ri-*"> only — core.js's icon runtime hydrates them; no hand-written SVG
conventions.tokens: :root is never redeclared; the block's own variables are scoped to .alh

$fsx_token_compat_2026_07_28.severity: ROOT CAUSE — explains the majority of 'one ton of elements' wrong across every Apollo+ screen
$fsx_token_compat_2026_07_28.finding: The Design System component CSS (ds-components.css / market.css, verbatim from uni.theme.v2.1.css) sizes nearly everything through calc(Npx * var(--fsx)): .a-eve-title, .a-eve-date-day, .a-eve-tag, .date-day, .date-month, .event-action .status, .stat-value and dozens more. core.js injects --fs-u and --fs-r but NOT --fsx -- in the mockup that token comes from the page's own :root, which we deliberately do not port. Every one of those calc() expressions was therefore INVALID, and CSS drops an invalid declaration entirely, so each element silently fell back to inherited sizing.
$fsx_token_compat_2026_07_28.measured_proof: Verified in a real browser (Claude in Chrome, cache-busted URL, logged-in session): getComputedStyle(document.documentElement) returned --fsx as MISSING while --fs-u was 1; .event-action .status computed to 17.69px where the DS specifies calc(var(--fsx) * .58rem) ~ 9px. Before/after screenshots confirm the same DOM going from truncated title + oversized badge + hidden venue meta to correct scale.
$fsx_token_compat_2026_07_28.why_it_looked_like_many_bugs: A single missing token degrades every sized element at once, which reads as 'the whole screen is wrong' rather than one defect. Three previous rounds chased individual symptoms (card background, arrows, badge) because the shared cause was invisible without computing styles in a real browser.
$fsx_token_compat_2026_07_28.fix: New apollo-plus-token-compat style block in aside-styles.php: .ax-body,.ax-shell,body{--fsx: var(--fs-u, var(--fs-r, 1))}. Declared on the shell's own classes, NOT on :root -- core.js owns :root and that rule stands. It inherits to every descendant so it repairs the whole component set at once, and defers automatically to a real --fsx the moment core.js ships one.
$fsx_token_compat_2026_07_28.applies_to: Every phase. Any screen in 003-011 that renders DS components depends on this token; without it they would each have reproduced the same failure.
